label: Arbeitnow
terms_note: Keyless public JSON API; the earlier audit recorded the board's ask for a source credit / link back. No proposal or messaging surface — the board carries no bidding, contracts or escrow.

auth: 1. No account needed for the public feed; the tenant applies on the posting's own application page (assist card).

endpoints.notes: data[]: slug, company_name, title, description (HTML), remote, url, tags[], job_types[], location, created_at (unix)

reference.limits: - No key, no published rate limit; the board asks for a source credit / link back (earlier audit). - No bid / message / contract surface — Arbeitnow is a board; the employer's page takes the application.

search_postings.note: Keyless feed whose only documented parameter is page, so query and location are not sent — filter the returned postings client-side; the page size is fixed by the platform (do not pass limit). description is HTML; remote, tags[], job_types[] and created_at (type not documented on the page) are in raw. Terms: the API is provided 'as is' and 'We may revoke the permission to use API at any time'; no published rate limit. Mirrors the jobs/arbeitnow search: these are employment listings; buyer is the employer, and apply happens on the posting's url.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none') and no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: No per-id endpoint is documented; the feed returns whole records.
